title: Idle merge game with pigeons made entirely on my phone
author: Real-Car-1561
selftext:
Whilst on a road trip I decided to try some game dev on my phone since I have the chatgpt app on it. This game was inspired by cow evolution, and was fully developed on my smartphone. I'm not sure what model was used as from what I could see the effort was the only thing that could be changed (I used extra high).

The only annoying thing about doing all this on a phone is that it makes new html files you have to download every single time you ask it to make a change. When I get home I'll definitely get codex with gpt 6 astra to work on it and see how it improves it.
